_comment: Per-signal log-likelihood weights for InferenceResult.confidence. Each weight is added to a running sum; the final confidence is sigmoid(sum), i.e. a real probability in [0, 1]. fit_method='prior' means these are documented prior assumptions; replace with logistic-regression coefficients fit on the labeled dataset by setting fit_method='logistic_regression' and updating fit_date.

_weight_rationale.os_family_purl: Strong signal. PURLs are emitted by Trivy's parser; rarely wrong unless the SBOM was tampered with.
_weight_rationale.os_family_metadata: Moderate signal. Metadata component name (e.g. 'ubuntu:22.04') can be misleading on custom images.
_weight_rationale.os_family_contradiction: Penalty. When purls say one family but components say another the SBOM is inconsistent; reduce overall confidence.
_weight_rationale.language_from_sbom: Moderate signal. SBOM component names and ecosystems are reliable but the version may be transitive rather than authoritative.
_weight_rationale.language_override: Strongest signal. The operator told us explicitly.
_weight_rationale.libc_explicit: Small positive. Knowing the libc rules out a class of incorrect targets but does not by itself confirm the rest.
_weight_rationale.variant_detected: Small positive. Variant (apache/nginx/etc.) is a niche refinement.
_weight_rationale.default_intercept: Slight negative prior so a totally signal-free SBOM ends up around 0.38 (below the 0.5 threshold) and triggers low-confidence handling.
